commit.message:
Read the draft's own mask embedding when its release ships one

A draft's rows after its anchor read the target's token table row of the
mask token. Qwen3.5-122B-A10B's row, which Ornith-1.5-122B inherits, is
of order 1e-6, below what the fp16 block scales of GGUF Q8_0 and the
K-quants hold, so a GGUF of the family reads zeros there, and the
draft's acceptance on code and reasoning halves (about 2.3 tokens per
cycle against 4.9 on the MLX target, which keeps the row).

A DFlash2 release may now ship the mask token's BF16 embedding beside
its weights, mask_embedding.safetensors holding one tensor
mask_embedding of the hidden size. Installation fetches it with the
weights; the draft checkpoint keeps it in model.bin after the
selector's codebooks; and after each draft input gather one dispatch
(draft_mask_rows) sets every lane's mask rows to it. A draft without
the file loads and runs as before.

With the file beside incoai/Ornith-1.5-122B-DFlash2's weights,
unsloth/Ornith-1.5-122B-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL drafts 4.7 tokens per cycle on
the same coding prompts with every row verified. Resident on an M5 Max,
one lane of the backend benchmark decodes 150 tok/s against 71 before
(6.40 tokens per cycle against 3.05), and one coding stream over HTTP
105 tok/s against 40.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

applicability: Upstream failure is tiny Ornith/Qwen3.5 mask embedding rounded to zero by GGUF block quantization. Current local Flash Next target is required BF16 embedding and draft_input reads BF16 directly; no direct evidence this failure affects current checkpoint. Separate local reviewer checked actual mask row; see parent report.
